item.title: Daxin Materials accelerates semiconductor push with 12 products in mass production
item.summary: Daxin Materials is expanding its semiconductor footprint, with semiconductor materials accounting for nearly 23% of revenue in the second quarter of 2026. The company expects the segment to reach 25% to 26% of full-year revenue, driven by 12 products already in mass production and a further 14 under customer validation.
